The catalog search calls the shop's API and updates the page when the response
arrives. With a network delay, the result count changes a moment later. The
wrong fix is a longer `Sleep`; the right fix is a **getter assertion that
auto-waits** for the value.

The catalog page takes a `?delay=<ms>` flag that slows the search response, so
you can prove the wait is real.

## Task 1 — Search with a network delay and let the assertion wait

**Goal:** create `checks/search.robot` that signs in, opens the catalog with a
delay, searches, and lets the result-count assertion wait out the delay.

Here is the same wait over a different search term and delay. Adapt it to search
`mug` with an `800` ms delay.

<!-- example -->
```robotframework
*** Settings ***
Library     Browser
Resource    ../resources/shop.resource

*** Test Cases ***
Lamp Search Waits For The Network
    New Browser    chromium    headless=True
    New Context
    New Page    ${BASE_URL}/login
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-username    primary_user
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-password    learning-password
    Click    data-testid=login-submit
    New Page    ${BASE_URL}/catalog?delay=500
    Fill Text    data-testid=catalog-search    lamp
    Click    data-testid=search-submit
    Get Text    data-testid=result-count    ==    1
    Close Browser
```
<!-- /example -->

**Check:** the suite defines `Search Waits For The Network`.

<!-- hint -->
Open the catalog with the delay flag: `New Page    ${BASE_URL}/catalog?delay=800`,
then `Fill Text    data-testid=catalog-search    mug` and click `search-submit`.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- hint -->
Don't `Sleep` — the getter assertion waits for you. Assert
`Get Text    data-testid=result-count    ==    1` and it retries through the delay.
<!-- /hint -->
<!-- solution -->
```robotframework
*** Settings ***
Library     Browser
Resource    ../resources/shop.resource

*** Test Cases ***
Search Waits For The Network
    New Browser    chromium    headless=True
    New Context
    New Page    ${BASE_URL}/login
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-username    primary_user
    Fill Text    data-testid=login-password    learning-password
    Click    data-testid=login-submit
    New Page    ${BASE_URL}/catalog?delay=800
    Fill Text    data-testid=catalog-search    mug
    Click    data-testid=search-submit
    Get Text    data-testid=result-count    ==    1
    Close Browser
```
<!-- /solution -->

## Task 2 — Run it green

Run:

```bash
uv run robot checks
```

**Check:** the search settles at one matching product without a `Sleep`.
